title: Speciesism in AI: Evaluating Discrimination Against Animals in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses across three paradigms: 1) SpeciesismBench, a custom benchmark to assess recognition and moral evaluation of speciesist statements; 2) Administering psychological measures and moral dilemmas (e.g., prioritizing humans versus animals in sinking-boat or disease-rescue scenarios) to compare LLM choices with human data; 3) Analyzing open-ended text generation tasks for euphemisms, rationalizations, or refusals regarding harm toward farmed versus non-farmed animals.
